business_problem: When Uber Technologies moved its on-premises datacenters to a cloud service, the company took the opportunity to assess whether they should also move their automated processes to the cloud or consider another automation platform.
solution_summary: Uber Technologies used Power Automate, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 to replace repetitive operational work with automation. When Uber Technologies moved its on-premises datacenters to a cloud service, the company took the opportunity to assess whether they should also move their automated processes to the cloud or consider another automation platform. Key implementation elements included Power Automate automates workflow steps that previously required manual effort; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Microsoft 365 provides the documents, messages, and meetings that feed user workflows. The solution also connects with ERP, helping the new platform fit into existing operations. Source metrics include Automation with Power Automate is saving Uber more than $9 million a year; The company plans to automate another 30 business processes in 2025, leading to an additional $4 million in estimated annual savings....
